issues.explanation: Entire auth flow ships without any Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating TDD and required unauthorized/tamper coverage.
Livewire submit() uses inline $this->validate([...]) without #[Validate] attributes required by the project pattern.
Email rules use plain 'email' without a strict qualifier despite the task requiring strict validation.
Register hits the RateLimiter before validation and never clears it, so validation failures consume the 5-attempt quota.
Guest routes rely on web middleware only with no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so update requests may bypass guest after initial load.
No CHANGELOG/docs update accompanies the new auth flow despite the docs-freshness convention.
Welcome view drops the @fonts directive in the same edit, an unrelated one-line change.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:194 uses $this->validate([...]) with no #[Validate]; no tests or CHANGELOG in diff; redirects/routes use route() correctly e.g. routes/web.php:1018

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:118-127, app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:216-232: small focused methods, clear names, {{ }} escaping throughout

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:1017-1041 covers all named routes; app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:201-213 auth.failed+throttle+regenerate+intended home; app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:95-99 always status; verify via EmailVerificationRequest at app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationController.php:40; gap: plain 'email' at app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:195

scope.evidence: all new controllers/components/views/lang/routes serve auth/localization; only incidental edit is removal of `@fonts` at resources/views/welcome.blade.php:937

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:199-226 rate-limited + __('auth.failed')/__('auth.throttle'); PasswordResetController rotates remember_token + fires PasswordReset; EmailVerificationRequest enforces 403; {{ }} escaping, @csrf, $fillable all correct

simplicity.evidence: reuses Password::defaults() at app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:345, Password/RateLimiter facades, EmailVerificationRequest; no service layers or abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/, no Pest files; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests

review.summary: Adds complete session auth with Livewire login/register, password reset/verification controllers, pt_BR-first localization and named-route conventions. Functionally and security-wise strong, but ships with zero tests and misses the #[Validate] project pattern, so it needs substantial rework before merge.
